==Biography==
Pedro Luiz '''"LEP"''' Marcari began playing online games when he was 7-8 years old, when he started playing games in the MMORPG genre. In early 2011, LEP picked up League of Legends and has been "completely hooked" on the MOBA genre ever since.

== Trivia ==
* Known for his {{ci|Irelia}},{{ci|Shen}} and {{ci|Malphite}} play.
* Portrayed as {{ci|Irelia}} in the CBLoL 2015 official wallpaper.
* Was considered by many as the best Brazilian Top Laner, due to his flexibility and diverse champion pool.
* Infamously remembered for his performances in the [[2014 Season World Championship]]:
** After a bad Teleport play against [[Cloud9]], the Brazilian community started to call any bad TP play a "'''LEP TP'''" or "'''teLEPort'''".
** Had a 0/16/2 K/D/A after 3 games, which became a meme in the community after the broadcast showed the statline together with a single shot of Lep.<ref>[https://youtu.be/djMnEUKGKRY?t=75 KBM vs NWS - 2014 World Championship Groups C and D D3G4] ''youtube.com''</ref>
{{PlayerStatsTrivia}}
